# AIwareness

> AIwareness (aiwareness.space) helps people, entrepreneurs and organisations understand AI risk and work towards a safe transition to advanced AI, through awareness, alignment and agency. It is a mission-driven initiative founded by Robin Hotz, with a team of facilitators and coaches at the Cocreation Loft, Schinkestraße 9, 12047 Berlin, Germany. The website is in English and German.

AIwareness is part of the AI safety field and builds bridges to people outside it: grounded, sourced and honest about uncertainty. Every number and expert statement on the site carries a named source and a link, and every offer ends with something concrete to do. Contact: through the form at https://aiwareness.space/contact. Paid company workshops and 1:1 coaching for paying clients are offered by Robin Hotz at https://robin-hotz.com.

## Offers

Three ways in: Awareness (talks and education), Alignment (workshops and spaces) and Agency (coaching and programmes).

- [Awareness: talks and education on AI safety](https://aiwareness.space/services/talks-and-education): keynotes and talks, Sense-Making Evenings, newsletter, blog, resources, and formats for schools and communities.
- [Alignment: workshops and spaces](https://aiwareness.space/services/organisational-development): workshops and spaces where teams and groups make sense of AI together: open sense-making formats and workshops for groups, NGOs, schools and mission-driven teams. Approach: Assess, Align, Act.
- [Agency: coaching and programmes](https://aiwareness.space/services/ai-coaching): the AI AGENCY programme with group calls, and guidance into AI safety paths such as reading lists, courses and careers.
- [AI-assisted sense-making for AI events](https://aiwareness.space/services/ai-assisted-sense-making): live graphic recording by Robin Hotz, data capture and AI-assisted analysis checked by people.
- [All offers](https://aiwareness.space/solutions)

## Learn and take part

- [AI talks and events](https://aiwareness.space/events): talks and keynotes, speeches at demonstrations and public events such as Fairness Jetzt in Berlin (31 October 2026, video on the page), Sense-Making Evenings at the Cocreation Loft and online calls.
- [AI safety resources](https://aiwareness.space/resources): recommended free courses, videos, books, articles and reports.
- [Blog and newsletter](https://aiwareness.space/newsletter): notes on AI safety and what each of us can do.
